name: N.D. Metal Industries Limited
about: N.D. Metal Industries Limited manufactures and trades in non-ferrous metals and alloys in India. It is involved in metal casting activities. The company also offers ingots, wire bar, rods, plates, sheets, tubes, and pipes. In addition, it provides clean metal of copper alloys, brass alloys, tin alloys, aluminum alloys, zinc alloys, and master alloys. Further, the company offers melting and re-rolling of scrap, waste, dross, residues of respective metals and zinc sulphate, and copper sulphate. Additionally, it imports tin, aluminum scrap, brass dross, zinc score, copper scrap, silicon metal, coal, and furnace oil. N.D. Metal Industries Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
